results.content:
Last Modified: May 15, 2026 [...] ### 

Per the Section 232 Presidential Proclamations, any steel or aluminum article subject to the Section 232 duties, except those eligible for admission under “domestic status” as defined in 19 CFR 146.43, and that is admitted into a U.S. foreign trade zone must be admitted as “privileged foreign status” as defined in 19 CFR 146.41, and will be subject upon entry for consumption to any ad valorem rates of duty related to the classification under the applicable HTS subheading. [...] If a good has a HTS classification subject to Section 232 measures on derivative steel and aluminum measures, and contains steel or aluminum content, see CSMS # 64384423 and # 64384496 for reporting instructions.

### 

For derivative steel, filers can report OTH for the country of melt and pour.

### 

No, there is no minimum amount of derivative steel or aluminum content provided for by Proclamations 10895 and 10896.
